test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: From the given options, select the one that correctly describes the meaning of 'Head Count Ratio'.

options.text: When the number of people with average income is estimated as the proportion of people on par with the poverty line
When the number of poor is estimated as the proportion of people above the poverty line
When the number of rich is estimated as the proportion of people on par with the poverty line
When the number of poor is estimated as the proportion of people below the poverty line

solution:
The correct answer is__** When the number of poor is estimated as the proportion of people below the poverty line.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The headcount ratio (HCR) is the population proportion that survives, or lives, lower than the poverty threshold.
 
• One of the unpleasant qualities of the headcount ratio is that it disregards the depth of poverty; if the poor become poorer, the headcount index does not change.
 
• For example, the poverty headcount ratio at the national poverty line in India was last described at 21.9% in 2011. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The Head Count Ratio is planned with the following method. 

HCL = Number of people living below the poverty line/Total population of the country.

The Head Count Ratio (HCR) is the percentage of a population that falls below the Poverty Line.

The Head Count Ratio is explained as the proportion of individuals living below the Poverty Line when the number of poor is approximate.__​__​
